faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIPS Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIPS Consultant posts is 24 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post at IIPS?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Consultant posts at the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Consultant Store Section post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant Store Section post, a Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics or related fields is required, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIPS Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIPS Consultant recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to IIPS Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant posts at IIPS is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for the IIPS Consultant positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification. Prepare your application carefully and send it before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these IIPS Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Consultant positions at IIPS is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which specific engineering degree is required for the Consultant NIDP post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant NIDP post, a Degree in Civil Engineering is required, along with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in planning and execution of civil works.

faq.answer: The Legal Advisor post requires a Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) with an enrolment with the Bar Council and 7-10 years of post-qualification experience.
